name: X (Twitter) CSV Analytics Ingest (x-csv-ingest)

nodes.name: Watch CSV Folder
nodes.notes: Watches ~/sync/devrel/x-analytics-exports/ for new CSV files dropped by operator. Operator exports from X Analytics dashboard weekly (manual 5min task). The n8n files/ mount maps to this directory.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO analytics_events (occurred_at, platform, content_id, event_type, metric_value, metadata) VALUES ($1::timestamptz, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (platform, content_id, event_type, occurred_at) DO UPDATE SET metric_value = EXCLUDED.metric_value, ingested_at = NOW()

notes: Phase V Part B — AC-8. Watches /files/x-analytics-exports/ for CSV drops. X API v2 costs $200/mo for analytics; operator exports manually from X Analytics dashboard weekly (~5 min). Drop new CSV → workflow fires → ingests → archives to processed/. Map /files/ in n8n compose to ~/sync/devrel/x-analytics-exports/ on host.
